summary_en: This study is testing the combination of balstilimab, botensilimab, and agenT-797 in adults with metastatic colorectal cancer that is microsatellite stable (pMMR) and has spread to the liver, who have had previous treatment. The study drugs are given by intravenous (IV) infusion in repeating 42-day cycles: balstilimab 240 mg on Days 1, 15, and 29 of each cycle for up to 9 cycles, botensilimab 75 mg on Day 1 of Cycles 1 through 4, and agenT-797 at 1.4 x 10^7 cells/kg on Day 1 of Cycle 1 and Day 15 of Cycle 2. The study is measuring the objective response rate (the share of participants whose tumor shrinks on imaging) and side effects, and it is a Phase 2 single-arm study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la combinación de balstilimab, botensilimab y agenT-797 en adultos con cáncer colorrectal metastásico con inestabilidad de microsatélites estable (pMMR) que se ha extendido al hígado y que ya recibieron tratamiento previo. Los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) en ciclos repetidos de 42 días: balstilimab 240 mg los días 1, 15 y 29 de cada ciclo, hasta 9 ciclos; botensilimab 75 mg el día 1 de los ciclos 1 a 4; y agenT-797 a 1.4 x 10^7 células/kg el día 1 del ciclo 1 y el día 15 del ciclo 2. El estudio mide la tasa de respuesta objetiva (el porcentaje de participantes cuyo tumor se reduce en las imágenes) y los efectos secundarios, y es un estudio de Fase 2 de un solo grupo.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with metastatic colorectal cancer that has spread to the liver
At least one measurable lesion, including a target lesion in the liver, per RECIST v1.1
Tumor confirmed as MSS/pMMR by an FDA-approved test
Received at least one prior line of systemic therapy with fluorouracil, oxaliplatin, and irinotecan
ECOG performance status 0-1 and life expectancy of at least 12 weeks
not_for: Prior treatment with PD-1, PD-L1, CTLA-4, or other immunotherapy
Bowel obstruction or recent obstruction within 3 months
Active or untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease
Active or recent autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment
